commands.command: cargo clippy --lib -- -D warnings -D unsafe_code -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::expect_used -D clippy::panic -D clippy::todo -D clippy::unimplemented -D clippy::indexing_slicing -D clippy::as_conversions

rules_satisfied: No production unsafe, unwrap, expect, panic, todo, unimplemented, unreachable, or assert macros
Empty input rejected first with typed ParseError::Empty
try_reserve called after empty check for bounded allocation
max_items enforced before each push with TooMany error
Parse failures returned as typed ParseError::Invalid via map_err
No lossy as conversions, unchecked indexing, or unchecked arithmetic
No hidden I/O in pure parse logic
Zero clippy warnings under strict lint gates
Split-by-comma iterated explicitly with for loop (not collect)
residual_risk: None. All absolute laws satisfied. Function uses safe Rust with typed errors, checked bounds, and bounded allocation. The Allocation error variant is returned in try_reserve's Err case but cannot actually occur on a single-threaded allocation of max_items u16s (capacity is bounded by max_items which is usize). This is structurally safe—no live panic or allocation-omission path exists beyond OOM which maps to the typed error.
